agents.name: CFO
agents.description: I keep Hunter's money picture: drift against the investment policy, pending decisions, and the daily snapshot.

agents.name: Focus Board
agents.description: I curate the attention board: what deserves attention now, what aged out, and what he dismissed.

agents.name: Brainy
agents.description: I hold what is true about Hunter and what he has decided: priorities, commitments, notes, and the log.

agents.name: Watch
agents.description: I read the newsletters he does not, and keep only what bears on a decision he is making.

agents.name: Nowgentic
agents.description: The work workspace. Its catchup brief runs every weekday morning.

agents.name: Assistant
agents.description: I am the way in. I read anything of Hunter's, hand judgment to the agent that owns it, and keep the morning brief.

agents.name: Myos
agents.description: I know how this dashboard and its agents work. I explain what Hunter is looking at, answer what the system is doing, and pass a message or a task to the agent that owns it.
